summary: Iteration 46 — Verified SA CoParents Align three-layer judicial features. Posted a message via court-thread-input + court-thread-send-btn: court-msg-<id> count went 1→2, court-thread-summary populated with 'On 2026-09-14 at 01:56 …' text + disclaimer 'Communication summary generated from the court–professional thread only. It is procedural, contains no findings, and is not a judicial recommendation.' within 2s (well under 20s budget). After page reload both messages persisted (count=2). (C) Pro (approval.test.pro1@gmail.com/TestPass2026!): /dashboard shows Court-Referred Cases inbox with 2 court-referral-thread-toggle-<refId>. Clicking the toggle for a863037b (same case judge posted in) reveals thread with the 2 judge messages; posted 'Pro reply from iter46 SDET' → count 2→3; success toast 'Message sent'. Communication summary auto-refreshed to now describe both court asks and the professional test reply ('appears to be a test message and does not provide a substantive status update'). Bi-directional flow confirmed end-to-end. (D) Immutable Case ID: backend test_case_id_assigned_at_referral_and_reused_by_case verifies referral.case_code (SA-YY-PFX-XXXXXX) is minted at referral and reused when the pro creates the case; CourtReferralsInbox.jsx line 52 and CourtDashboard.jsx line 73 both render it (falls back to '—' when null). Current preview inbox rows are legacy referrals without case_code — this matches the review note ('shows —; that's expected'). (E) Professional Statement extended fields (statement-role select, statement-materials checkboxes, statement-alignment_areas, statement-further_attention, statement-resources_considered, statement-current_status) verified via test_statement_role_and_materials_persist which PUTs role='mediator' + two materials and re-GETs. PDF inclusion verified in the same test file. (F) Regression: professional dashboard still renders (Court-Referred Cases tile + agreement invites); parent role unaffected (auth still works with role gating). No hard 500s in console; only 401 from unauthenticated /api/auth/me pre-login (expected).
critical_code_review_comments: CourtDashboard.jsx correctly falls back to '—' when case_code is null (line 73). Parents column uses `${done}/2` when case_id present else '—' — matches spec.
CourtReferralsInbox.jsx only renders court-referral-caseid-<id> when x.case_code truthy — legacy rows silently omit the label, which is per spec.
CourtThread integration: message POST triggers both email and AI communication_summary regeneration; UI polls/refreshes summary and disclaimer text is rendered verbatim.
App.js judge redirect (line ~39) correctly allow-lists /court/case/* so review-case navigation is not bounced back to /court-dashboard.

Backend court_messages / court_workflow permissions enforced: pro thread endpoints restricted to accepted/submitted referrals (covered by pytest test_court_thread_both_directions_with_summary_and_permissions).
seed_data_creation: Added 2 messages to referral a863037b-d749-4192-8d51-432c617180bb thread ('Judge test message from iter46' from judge, 'Pro reply from iter46 SDET' from pro). Non-destructive; simulates a real court-professional exchange for demo.

To exercise the case_code-visible UI path, create a fresh referral via POST /api/court-dashboard/refer as judge, then have approval.test.pro1 accept it — both judge table row and pro inbox will then show the SA-YY-PFX-XXXXXX code.
